newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican buys more than 1.1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican buys more than 1.1 mln shares.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Holdings Co said Friday it has repurchased more than 1.1 million shares of its common stock during the past three weeks. The company on March 6 announced its intent to buy back up to $200 million in common stock.
"We intend to complete the stock repurchase no later than December 31, 1998," said Philip Lindner, chief financial officer.
The $200 million authorization will allow the repurchase of more than 10 percent of shares outstanding at current market prices.
The company, parent to MidAmerican Energy Co, MidAmerican Capital Co and Midwest Capital Group Inc, now has about 100 million shares outstanding.
